scientific_integrity: An all-odd-prime, all-depth local-ring statement with a complete proof and separate exact integer enumeration checks; no independent specialist validation or exhaustive historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to rank-one idempotents in 2x2 matrices over the cyclic ring modulo odd prime powers of exponent at least two.
Only the unweighted fourth Fourier moment is determined; no unrestricted coefficient-extension norm is established.
The field-depth analog is prior work and explicitly excluded from the novelty claim.
General earlier local quadratic density formulas might contain the result.
title: Complete projector-pair convolution over odd prime-power rings
